headline: Approved updated policy on First Report of Injury and new policy on Unmanned Aircraft Systems.
summary: Members approved the minutes of a September 4, 2026 special meeting. They also approved two police policies: an update to Policy 004-005 and new Policy 033-001 on Unmanned Aircraft Systems.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 4, 2026 special meeting, unanimously.
Approved Update Policy 004-005: First Report of Injury, unanimously.
Approved New Policy 033-001: Unmanned Aircraft Systems, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Zachery made a motion to approve the special meeting minutes of September 4, 2026. Commissioner White seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.
Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve Policy 004-005: First Report of Injury. Commissioner White seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.
Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve Policy 033-001: Unmanned Aircraft Systems. Commissioner Hampton seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.

decision_titles: Update Policy 004-005: First Report of Injury
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Police Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
5:30 PM, October 14, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Police 
Department 
2900 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 Chairman Willis called the Police Commission regular meeting to order at 5:38 PM 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 The Police Commission clerk, Nancy Forvil, took a roll call. Commissioner's present: Willis, 
Zachery, Hampton, White and Ladore. 
 
Other staff: Chief Reynolds, Lieutenant Mckeon, Attorney Sharkey 
 
Other: 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  a. Approval of minutes of the Police Commission special meeting on September 4, 2026  
  Commissioner Zachery made a motion to approve the special meeting minutes of 
September 4, 2026. Commissioner White seconded the motion. The vote was 
unanimous in favor. 
 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 There was no public comment. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 
 
  a. Correspondence
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 At 5:55 PM, Chairman Willis made a motion to enter into executive session to have the 
Police Commission attorneys provide an update on open cases. Commissioner Hampton 
seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
 
At 6:27 PM, Chairman Willis made a motion to come out of executive session. 
Commissioner Zachery seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
7. REPORTS 
  
 
 
  a. Hamden Police Department September 2026 Monthly Report  
  
 
  b. Hamden Police Department September 2026 Crime Statistics Report  
  
 
  c. Hamden Police Department September 2026 Traffic Stop Count Report  
  
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 There was no old business. 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  a. Review and approve Update Policy 004-005: First Report of Injury.  
  Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve Policy 004-005: First Report of 
Injury. Commissioner White seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. 
  b. Review and approve New Policy 033-001: Unmanned Aircraft Systems  
  Commissioner Ladore made a motion to approve Policy 033-001: Unmanned Aircraft 
Systems. Commissioner Hampton seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in 
favor. 
  c. Police Commission attorney providing an update on open cases.  
  
 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to adjourn 
the Police Commission's regular meeting. Commissioner Zachery seconded the motion. The 
vote was unanimous in favor. The meeting adjourned at 6:41 PM.
